g.text: M3a stop request, actual return and Host-owned disposal
first reason wins shared lock / CancelRequested
M2 native inspection is synchronous and returns on its own.
Token cancellation is not native stop completion.
reject persistence when stop already accepted
If Host disposes during a run: close new admission,
request Shutdown, then wait for the same completion.
Persisting rejects late stop requests and must finish saving.
Native Start/RequestStop/Wait and native callbacks arrive in M3b.
